name: NordPass
summary: Password manager from the makers of NordVPN for individuals, families and companies: password sharing, breach monitoring, MFA and SSO, with admin controls on the business plans.
best_for: small and mid-sized companies that want a simple password manager with sharing and breach monitoring, and individuals who want a cheap first year of Premium
skip_if: you are a team of two or three that does not want to pay for a 5- or 10-seat minimum, or you need Entra ID or Okta SSO without paying for Enterprise
honest_knock: Teams is sold only as a 10-user pack and Business and Enterprise have a 5-user minimum, so very small teams pay for empty seats. SSO with Entra ID, ADFS or Okta is only on Enterprise. The Free plan does not sync across devices, and personal prices are introductory for the first term, with a higher regular price shown next to them. Prices exclude VAT. We have not used NordPass ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month for the first year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-08 and re-read 2026-10-14, unchanged, on nordpass.com/pricing in a browser render from a Netherlands connection, EUR, excluding VAT, on the 2-year, 1-year and 1-month tabs) Personal plans: Premium is €1.99 a month on the 1-year plan (€23.88 for the first 12 months, shown against €35.88) or €1.39 a month on the 2-year plan with 3 extra months (€37.53 for the first 27 months, against €80.73); Family, for 6 user accounts, is €3.69 a month on 1 year (€44.28 for the first 12 months) or €2.49 on 2 years (€67.23 for the first 27 months). Personal plans carry a 30-day money-back guarantee. Business plans, per user per month: Teams €1.99 on 1 year, €1.79 on 2 years and €2.49 billed monthly, sold as a 10-user pack only; Business €3.99, €3.59 and €5.99 with a 5-user minimum; Enterprise €5.99, €5.39 and €7.99 with a 5-user minimum. The page offers an extra 10% off annual Business and Enterprise plans with the code NPFALL26. Teams includes password generation and sharing, offline access, activity monitoring, company-wide security settings, MFA and SSO with Google Workspace; Business adds group and folder sharing, password strength and data breach monitoring and a Vanta compliance integration; Enterprise adds SSO with Entra ID, MS ADFS and Okta, automatic user provisioning and Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk integrations. The Free plan has autosave, autofill and secure storage, but not access on multiple devices, password health or the breach scanner, and includes a 30-day Premium trial. The personal prices are introductory for the first term; the page shows the higher regular figure next to each.

compare_with.name: 1Password
compare_with.why: 1Password is in our dossiers too and is the more established choice for teams that want polished admin controls and integrations. NordPass is cheaper per seat on its yearly business plans but sells Teams only in 10-user packs and keeps Entra ID and Okta SSO for Enterprise.
